|lore=Alliance Intelligence expends considerable resources to infiltrate the Imperial military bureaucracy, but the ISB’s security sweeps make these shadowy operations dangerous.
|game_text=Deploy on your spy at a site. Spy is now Undercover. During your control phase, may take one Sabotage into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. At same and related sites, opponent’s [[Permanent Weapon]] weapon destiny draws are -1 (-2 if targeting this character). (Immune to Alter.)
|printings={{Card versions/Undercover (A New Hope)}}
|notes=The 2006 slip places the same or related site condition first in its permanent weapon destiny clause. The [[Undercover (V) (Light) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Original)|original-edition slip]] survives in the consolidated PDF made in February 2003. The sheet gives 20 September 2002 as the set’s tournament-legality date, and the complete set was available by 21 September. The [[Undercover (V) (Light) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Remastered 2006)|2006 publication]] gives its text as of 4 December 2006.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153955/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards3.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 3, slip 24. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Undercover]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 3: Revolution#Cards|Virtual Set 3: Revolution]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
